integrity: Exact oriented 34-by-34 unimodular minor; independent exhaustive finite simplicial enumeration and signed Lefschetz traces; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite cyclic eleven-point biplane, unit graph metric and natural D22 subgroup only; no claim of full automorphism-group decomposition or general design theorem. Earliest day-precise source evidence is OEIS 2004-06-02; Brown's earlier April 2004 publication is month-precise.
title: Integral dihedral homology of the eleven-point biplane Vietoris–Rips complex
